race.comment: THREE WISHES (5) just under a month between runs with a tidy third over 1300m at this track on October 8. Clearly pleased the stable and will take holding out today. INVASION (7) finally comes up with a low gate fourth up and shapes as a top three contender. Kept finding with a respectable fourth over 1300m at this track. Has his share of talent and expected to go close. WINTER GARDEN (6) appreciated the drop in grade when she circled the field for a tenacious second at the big odds over 1300m at this track. Can hold a forward position and take catching. TOO HOT TO HANDLE (10) best effort in four career starts when he resumed with a handy fourth in a small field at Goulburn over 1100m. Should come on from that run and will appreciate the extra distance.
